sources.title: Infra-oriented V4.1-Flash architecture study (parameter accounting)
sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: The study derives 551,566,180,464 backbone parameters (advertised 552B) and 196,928,504,320 Engram parameters (advertised 196B) from safetensors headers of all 48 shards, cross-checked against config.json and inference/model.py, with per-token 16.13B decode / 7.90B prefill under DeepSeek's counting convention.
claims.context: Study page fully consumed this pass (https://deepseek-v3.ezyang.com/studies/dsv41-flash.html); figures are the study's, cross-checked as described on-page.

claims.text: The 890 bytes/token global-KV headline falls out of the study's CSA2 accounting: 2.5 entries/token x (288B main FP4 + 68B indexer key); SWA caches are bounded and never persisted.
claims.context: Derivation-level; method disclosed on-page (Full/Reindex/Reuse roles, FP4 E2M1 + E4M3/E8M0 scales).

claims.text: The page explicitly discloses AI-drafted, human-unedited status and names its primaries (V4.1 tech-report PDF, checkpoint config.json, reference model.py, safetensors headers).
claims.context: First-party disclosure on-page; governs the lead-not-authority handling.

limitations.text: Tensor-level derivations not re-verified independently (no checkpoint inspection this pass).
limitations.context: Evidence boundary retained for downstream editorial use.

limitations.text: Vision tower (485M) and DSpark drafter (14.2B) excluded from backbone counts per stated convention.
limitations.context: Evidence boundary retained for downstream editorial use.

targets.finding: Study page fully consumed: disclosure, derivation method, parameter/KV figures extracted; independent tensor re-verification outstanding.
Cross-check chain (report PDF + config + model.py + headers) confirmed as stated on-page; figures match advertised 552B/196B/16B/8B/890B; lead-not-authority handling applied per disclosure.
